rationale: Jakob and Devaj both work in robotics manipulation but from complementary angles—Jakob brings production robotics software and data engineering systems at New Theory, while Devaj is researching the perception and control foundations for dexterous manipulation at UC Berkeley. They share conviction on embodied AI and could explore how real-world robotics data pipelines intersect with vision-based and contact-aware control research.
intro_message: Jakob Kaiser, meet Devaj Gupta — you're both focused on robot manipulation but from different vantage points (production systems vs. embodied learning research), and could compare notes on bridging software infrastructure with tactile sensing and vision-based control.
